pages.name: Anubis
pages.text: The $(deity)Jackal-Headed God$() of death and judgment.

pages.title: Guardian of Tombs
pages.text: $(deity)Anubis$() is a neutral entity who guards sacred tombs. He will not attack unless provoked, but his judgment is swift and merciless.$(br2)If you prove yourself worthy, he may grant you his protection.

pages.title: Anubis's Mercy
pages.text: $(tip)"Anubis has judged you worthy. You are under his protection."$(br2)When granted mercy, Anubis will not attack you and may even assist against other threats. Maintain respect for the dead to keep his favor.
